question: Can a source-blind finite literal lexicon deterministically recover a bounded cross-publisher passage packet for one or more frozen combat topology keys without resuming failed full-rule model coding?

blindLexicon.phraseRule: For every assigned label return one to three lower-case ASCII literal phrases, each one to four whitespace-separated words. The first phrase is the label lower-cased with underscores changed to spaces. Additional phrases may be ordinary rules-language surface forms. No regex, wildcard, stemming, game name, source claim or cross-label phrase reuse.
blindLexicon.outputRule: Strict JSON object keyed by every assigned uppercase label in protocol order. Values are arrays in proposed order. No missing or extra labels and no prose outside the JSON.
blindLexicon.ownerRule: The owner hash-verifies and transcribes each report once without adding, deleting, reordering or editing a phrase.
blindLexicon.inconclusiveRule: Any source-corpus access, malformed/missing/extra label, phrase-rule breach, cap breach or prohibited action makes the screen inconclusive.

deterministicExtraction.implementation: One Python standard-library runner with an internal self-test; no dependency or model call.
deterministicExtraction.normalisation: Unicode NFKC, lower-case, collapse all whitespace to one ASCII space; literal substring match only.
deterministicExtraction.pdfPassage: Within each form-feed-delimited page, one or more consecutive non-empty extracted lines bounded by a blank line; preserve source ID, one-based page and passage index.
deterministicExtraction.textPassage: Each non-empty line is one passage; preserve source ID and one-based line number.
deterministicExtraction.matchRule: A key matches a passage only when at least one frozen literal for its producer timing, target surface, transform and consumer timing all occur in that same normalised passage.
deterministicExtraction.deduplication: One row per exact key, source and passage identity. Retain at most five passages per key/source in passage order.
deterministicExtraction.supportRule: A key is supported only in at least two sources from at least two publishers.
deterministicExtraction.selfTest: Must prove NFKC/lower/whitespace normalisation, page and line passage identity, four-part co-occurrence, support threshold, deduplication/caps and frozen ranking before the sole live run.
deterministicExtraction.correctionRule: One separately versioned correction may repair code or input plumbing only before any live output is used; source identities, lexicon, passages, codebook, caps, support, ranking and decision rules remain unchanged.

decision.success: At least one supported key fits every packet cap. Freeze the ranked packet only for a separately preregistered bounded semantic/closure review; no key is yet a mechanism candidate.
decision.futility: All identities and execution gates pass but no key reaches two-source/two-publisher literal support. Close only this literal screen.
decision.inconclusive: Any blind-lexicon fault, source/hash fault, self-test failure, live runner fault, output/wall cap breach or exhausted correction.

prohibited: Resume or mine the failed full-rule model-coding outputs.
Adapt lexicon phrases after any source match is observed.
Treat a lexical passage match as semantic validity, closure survival, causal evidence or product fit.
